the_bureau_was_measured: Visit Denver, Visit Boulder and Visit Longmont are Simpleview installs whose listing pages omit the postal code; their own public listings endpoint states it, and is read with an EMPTY filter (every partner) so no category filter of the bureau's is trusted. Visit Aurora is a Craft CMS install on the Carlsbad / Jacksonville partner platform. Visit Golden and Visit Littleton are WordPress installs whose listing sitemaps carry no category.
the_category_filter_is_read_not_trusted: Simpleview partners are pulled UNFILTERED and each partner's OWN categories are read; every Aurora listing page is fetched and its OWN data-dms-category-name is read, because a directory's category filter may be INERT.
a_roster_row_is_not_a_policy: Tier-3 IDENTITY and ROUTING evidence. The bureau's category PROPOSES that a partner is lodging; the property's own page decides what it is. No roster row carries a pet policy.
the_bureau_does_not_decide_membership: Admission is the property's OWN postal code against the corridor registry and nothing else.
